items.t: Cisco Stocks Fall 5.29% as AI Networking Mix Squeezes Gross Margins
items.sum: Record $18.5 billion revenue and a doubled AI outlook were overshadowed by a 2.5-point drop in non-GAAP gross margin.

items.t: Cisco CEO Shrugs Off Concerns On Revenue Guidance Dip, Says ‘Profitability Of The Business Is Incredible’
items.sum: In an interview with CNBC, Cisco CEO Chuck Robbins said the sequential decline in the company’s second-quarter revenue outlook reflects a seasonal pattern, not a deterioration in demand.

items.t: Cerebras Soars on Sales; Cisco Down on Expectations Miss | Stock Movers
items.sum: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Shares of Cerebras Systems (CBRS) soared ahead of the US market open after the chipmaker gave a sales guidance well above estimates, while unveiling new deals with Oracle and Microsoft. A key investor concern is a rollout delay in the firm's contract with OpenAI. - Shares of Cisco Systems (CSCO) declined in the early session after the networking gear maker report

items.t: Cisco Stock Falls After Earnings Beat Fails to Ease Long-Term Concerns
items.sum: The networking company reported better-than-expected results for its fiscal first quarter and lifted its outlook for the rest of the year.

items.t: Cisco Slides 5% Despite Raising AI Outlook to $9 Billion as Citi Says Growth May Have Peaked; Hewlett Packard Enterprise Retreats 5%, Arista Falls 3%
items.sum: Cisco posted record revenue and handed investors a bigger AI forecast, yet the shares still sold off hard. One number in the next quarter's guide has analysts asking whether the best growth is already behind the networking giant.

items.t: Cisco: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.sum: Headcount fell while revenue rose, so the operating leverage behind the next phase of growth may matter as much as the AI story.
